hook: No, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash will not run on any of these
items: Flagship phone: No, smallest quant read is 359 GB
Laptop, 8 GB, no GPU: No, needs 80 GiB free RAM
MacBook Air, 16 GB: No, needs 80 GiB free RAM
RTX 4060, 8 GB: No, needs a 32 GB GPU
RTX 4090, 24 GB: No, asks for a 32 GB GPU
HLE 42.6: Hard exam questions without tools; Opus 5 scores 56.3
the_catch: These scores come from DeepSeek's own model card. The card lists no limitations and gives no memory needs.
caption: DeepSeek's model card gives no memory figures. The one quantized repo we read lists a 359.32 GB file and asks for a 32 GB GPU and 128 GB of RAM. Save this for the next open model. What do you run models on?
alt_text: A cheat sheet asking whether DeepSeek V4.1 Flash runs on a phone, an 8 GB laptop, a 16 GB MacBook Air, an RTX 4060 and an RTX 4090. The answer for each is no. Below are three benchmark scores and the catch.
